        int n = in.nextInt();
        int B = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        int[] costs = new int[n];

        int odd = 0;

                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            if (i < n - 1 && even == odd && even != 0) {
                costs[costCount++] = Math.abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]);
            }

        Arrays.sort(validCosts);

        int cuts = 0;
        for (int cost : validCosts) {
            if (B >= cost) {
                B -= cost;
                cuts++;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(cuts);
    }
}

        int B = s.nextInt();

        int[] arr = new int[n];

            arr[i] = s.nextInt();
        }

        PriorityQueue<Integer> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        int balance = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            balance += (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;

            if (balance == 0 && i < n - 1) {
                pq.add(Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));

        }

        int cuts = 0;

            B -= pq.poll();
            cuts++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        }

        List<Integer> costs = IntStream.range(0, n - 1)

        int count = 0;

            if (B >= cost) {
                B -= cost;
                count++;
            }

        System.out.println(count);
